svg.title: DIA-401 · A Double-Edged Knife
svg.desc: A flow map. A stream of consulting work enters from the left and forks into two channels of equal width, divided by a jagged ridge, the frontier of what the AI does well. Past a dashed line where the tool is handed over, the upper channel, tasks the AI does well, takes on three tributaries from above, each drawn to scale: 12.2 percent more tasks finished, 25.1 percent faster, and quality up 40 percent and more. It leaves the plate more than three times as wide as it entered. The lower channel, a task just past the reach of the AI, sheds a rust strand that curls away and runs out: 19 percentage points of right answers, lost. It leaves the plate narrower than it entered. From a preregistered field experiment of 758 consultants.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 1 · DOES IT MAKE YOU BETTER?
a task just past its reach
The jagged line between the channels is the frontier
of what the AI does well.
Width is the number: each tributary and the lost strand are drawn to one scale. The stream before the tool is not measured.
DIA-401 · One tool, one study: the work gains three streams on one side of a jagged frontier and loses one on the other.
